business_problem: Manual processes hinder Good360’s efforts to get product donations to the people who need them. Good360 has been bridging the gap between surplus and demand since 1983, when it was founded to help distribute $12 million worth of donated office equipment to nonprofits.
solution_summary: Good360’s manual processes slowed their ability to distribute essential goods to communities in crisis. Agentforce will speed up distribution and automate donation matching for greater impact. How Good360 Did It How Good360 Did It Agentforce-powered resource matching is expected to triple Good360’s disaster recovery impact. Good360 is taking their mission to the next level with Agentforce — the agentic layer of the Salesforce Platform . To get goods to disaster-affected communities faster, they’re building a resource-matching agent that automates the donation routing process. Agentforce prioritizes communities that could use the donation most while recommending the nearest location, to reduce fuel consumption. Powered by Data 360 , which harmonizes data from Nonprofit Cloud and third-party systems like NetSuite, Agentforce will instantly analyze donor, partner nonprofit, community, and logistics data to generate a curated list of top matches for each donation.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Runs the AI agent workflows that match donated goods to nonprofit demand and coordinate routing logistics.

solution_components.name: Data 360
solution_components.role: Unifies enterprise and behavioral data so teams can match donated goods to nonprofit demand and coordinate routing logistics with current context.

solution_components.name: Nonprofit Cloud
solution_components.role: Tracks nonprofit, donor, and fundraising records used to match donated goods to nonprofit demand and coordinate routing logistics.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Maps
solution_components.role: Visualizes partner and inventory locations to optimize how teams match donated goods to nonprofit demand and coordinate routing logistics.
